experiment.name: v121-final-l
experiment.description: METARGON v0.12.1 final paired runs, family L (ordered sequence), 4 seeds x 40 episodes, temporal-memory preservation check. Committed artifact: results/v121/final_l.json.
experiment.agent_version: metargon_v12 (v0.12.1 defaults: recent-credit off, temporal on for L)

metrics.success_rate: fraction of episodes completed (40 per seed)
metrics.exact_discovery_D1: fraction of episodes where a verified temporal hypothesis exactly matches the true ordered rule (first, second) for D1; predicted hypotheses not counted
metrics.exact_discovery_D2: fraction of episodes where a verified temporal hypothesis exactly matches the true ordered rule for D2
metrics.covered_discovery_D1: fraction of episodes where a verified hypothesis's antecedent is a subset of the true D1 rule
